memoryRule: the first directional proposal is held without geometry; a duplicate is refused; a different second proposal changes the 3D hinge and remains liftable
interactionRule: pointer, four direction buttons, arrow keys, and 1–4 propose a direction; only an incompatible pair commits; Enter/Space repeats the selected direction; Delete lifts latest; R/Escape releases
changedRule: Pressure and surface are refused as causes: only a contradiction between two different directional proposals can fold the self-portrait.
visibleConsequence: A committed contradiction changes actual WebGL fold angle, hinge axis, facet relief/cuts, and central void scale; the first proposal and a repeated proposal leave the rendered body exact.
falsifier: Delete if a single proposal changes geometry, repetition commits, the pointer location is the answer, contradiction changes only UI, later revisions reset, or exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v032 if caption-free viewing cannot show one suspended refusal object with a materially changed fold and negative seam, or if it reads as a generic 3D ornament.

encounterRupture: bounded pressure hold, single pulse, and three-station quorum -> propose a direction, then create an incompatible counterproposal
temporalRupture: pressure load, document order, and attention ledger -> a two-step contradiction gate where refusal precedes geometry
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D, semantic DOM/CSS, and inline SVG -> p5.js WebGL 3D object
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
